title: RETRY IS A ROW
why: His number 39, full controller navigation, keyboard and mouse first. When the browser blocks the player 2 window the title shows RETRY under the mode rows, but the arrow keys only walked the mode rows, so the keyboard could never reach RETRY and ENTER started a 1 player game instead. RETRY is now the last row the arrows land on while it shows, and ENTER on it presses it.
now: The arrow keys reach RETRY on the title, and ENTER presses it.
